name: crypto-60features-trading-agent-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for BTC/IRT and Crypto Algorithmic Trading with 60 Domain Capabilities, SQLite Persistence, High-Leverage Risk Execution, and Self-Improving Agent Loop

tools.name: execute_60_capabilities
tools.description: Executes all 60 domain capabilities of the crypto trading system, computes directional signals, logs each analysis to SQLite (data/trading.db), and returns full results.

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g. BTC/USDT, BTC/IRT, ETH/USDT)

tools.name: get_live_paper_account_state
tools.description: Retrieves current live paper trading account balance, free margin, total equity, open positions with live unrealized PnL, win rate, and bot status.

tools.name: manage_high_leverage_trade
tools.description: Executes or closes high leverage paper trades (e.g. 15x leverage) with dynamic stop-loss, take-profit, and automatic risk bounds verification.

tools.name: get_database_trades
tools.description: Queries closed trades, orders, and execution records directly from the persistent SQLite database (data/trading.db).

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return (1-100)

tools.name: get_60_feature_analyses
tools.description: Retrieves stored capability execution records and analyses from the SQLite capability_executions table.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

capability_id.description: Optional filter by capability ID (e.g. crypto_algo_trading, circuit_breaker)

tools.name: record_online_learning_feedback
tools.description: Provides external feedback or price observations directly into the agent’s reinforcement learning cycle, updating the 60 feature weights incrementally.

tools.name: train_agent_reinforcement_epoch
tools.description: Triggers a self-improvement training epoch on historical trade logs in SQLite. Updates the 60 feature weights vector, policy loss, and advances model generation (e.g. Gen-1 -> Gen-2).

notes.description: Optional description or trigger reason for this training epoch

tools.name: get_agent_lineage_and_evolution
tools.description: Returns the complete lineage, training epochs history, cumulative reward progression, 60-feature learned weights, and adaptive LLM prompt guidelines.

tools.name: evaluate_market_60_features_decision
tools.description: Calculates the multi-factor weighted consensus score across all 60 capabilities using the agent’s learned weights and provides a BUY / SELL / HOLD action recommendation with risk bounds.

tools.name: get_system_health_and_capabilities
tools.description: Provides complete diagnostic report on database integrity, active open positions, all 60 capabilities weights, and evolutionary agent generation.

tools.name: export_mcp_configuration
tools.description: Generates the Claude Desktop / Cursor / external MCP configuration JSON for connecting to this server.

tools.name: scan_all_crypto_markets
tools.description: Scans all 30+ supported cryptocurrency and Toman markets in real time, calculating RSI, volume surge (RVOL), EMA trends, profit opportunity score, and proposing short-term scalping setups with TP/SL.

tools.name: execute_opportunistic_scalp
tools.description: Executes a short-term opportunistic scalp trade on any crypto market (e.g. SOL/USDT, DOGE/USDT, PEPE/USDT, SUI/USDT, BTC/IRT) with calculated profit targets and stop losses.

resources.name: Detected Market Opportunities
resources.description: Real-time feed of multi-market scalping opportunities, profit potential scores, and TP/SL bounds

resources.name: Persistent SQLite Trades
resources.description: Real-time feed of recorded trades from data/trading.db

resources.name: Active Open Positions
resources.description: Live active open positions with real-time unrealized PnL, entry price, liquidation price, and leverage

resources.name: 60 Capability Execution Records
resources.description: Latest analytical outputs, recommendations, and status of all 60 features

resources.name: Agent & LLM Lineage Data
resources.description: Epoch history, reward curves, and feature weight progression

resources.name: Continuous Online Learning Stream
resources.description: Feed of micro-learning observations recorded by the self-improving agent

resources.name: Trading System Health & Stats
resources.description: SQLite database record counts and service status

prompts.name: quant_market_analysis
prompts.description: Analyzes market conditions using the consensus of all 60 trading system capabilities.

prompts.name: high_leverage_risk_assessment
prompts.description: Evaluates capital protection, liquidation distance, and margin utilization before taking high-leverage positions.

prompts.name: agent_self_reflection_and_learning
prompts.description: Prompts LLM to review recent closed trades from SQLite and formulate updated rules for the self-improving agent.

arguments.name: min_trades
arguments.description: Minimum number of recent trades to inspect

crypto-trading-agent.description: Adaptive Crypto Agent with 60 Features & SQLite Persistence
